_comment_layout: Copy this file to C:\PMDSync\config.json on the PC that runs the sync, and fill in real values. Never commit the real file to git. Secrets (Epicor password / API key) live in Windows Credential Manager — see docs/DEPLOYMENT.md section D.
_comment_auth: Two SharePoint auth modes. Pick ONE. For temporary dev use on your own PC, use Interactive (no Entra app needed). For production unattended on the shop-floor PC, use Certificate.
